newsitem.title: USA: Minntech targeted in Avecor suit.
newsitem.headline: Minntech targeted in Avecor suit.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said Friday it filed a lawsuit against Minntech Corp seeking to invalidate a Minntech patent on a medical device used during surgery.

A spokesman for Avecor said the so-called oxegenator device is used during surgery to replace the function of human lungs. He added Avecor believes Minntech's patents for the device are invalid. The company also wants a determination that its oxegenator does not infringe on Minntech patents, he said.
Minntech officials were not available for comment.
Avecor makes and markets specialty medical devices.
Its shares were up 1/4 Friday at 13.
